properties.description:
Recorded with add_epoch because it HAPPENED: the third and last item of the planned increment epoch:planned-the-mechanism-reaches-the-moment (sequence 490) landed on 2026-09-14. Sequence 494 places it after 491 (the lens on the loop rail), 492 (the status claim is the trigger) and 493 (the reader is offered, never assumed).

WHAT ARRIVED. The root-cause walk on the fix-without-recorded-cause field report, recorded as fact:root-cause-a-default-put-every-reconcile-pass-into-the-fix-population-and-the-gap-offered-to-decline-the-rule, and the three sub-items the report recorded, each fixed at the cause: (a) a design_holds acceptance on a baselined artifact must say why the code moved — no default; (b) the gap text is a standing rule with a triage recipe and never offers to decline the rule; (c) the detector tells checksum acceptances from repairs by construction and names the ones wearing a fix label for relabelling. Five acceptance tests and three detector tests, the five load-bearing ones observed failing first.

WHAT DID NOT ARRIVE, and said so: the 2026-09-07 date-boundary ruling (dec:the-no-cause-fix-gap-grandfathers-fixes-recorded-before-the-rule-existed) is accepted and still unbuilt; the as_built_aligned disposition stays an open idea; reflow2's own 142 mislabelled acceptances are named by the detector and not relabelled — a triage pass for a session with the owner's word. With this the planned increment's three walks are delivered and it can be marked arrived on Anthony's word.
properties.name: ARRIVED 2026-09-14 — the reason for a code movement is asked, not defaulted; the no-cause gap states the discipline and a recipe; acceptances wearing a fix label are told apart from repairs: the third of the three walks in epoch:planned-the-mechanism-reaches-the-moment delivered
